construct: eIF2B is a five-subunit guanine nucleotide exchange factor that converts eIF2-GDP to eIF2-GTP, permitting translation initiation. Biallelic EIF2B-pathway loss-of-function variants impair eIF2B activity and cellular stress responses, producing vanishing white matter disease with episodes of rapid neurologic deterioration after fever, infection, or minor head trauma.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Stress-triggered neurologic deterioration, cystic white-matter rarefaction, and biallelic EIF2B5 variants identify vanishing white matter disease. eIF2B is the GEF that recharges eIF2-GDP to eIF2-GTP for translation initiation.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: eIF2-alpha phosphorylation is upstream regulation by stress kinases; rRNA assembly, mRNA polyadenylation, and ubiquitination are distinct cellular processes and not EIF2B's GEF activity.
adversarial_second_pass.expert_reviewer_reversal: The named EIF2B5 genotype and canonical white-matter/stress phenotype uniquely select guanine-nucleotide exchange.
